subject: New mail address: offer for Lima (LIM)
body:
Hello,

we are switching mail systems this week and my old mailbox is being closed. Please send your offer for our shipment to Lima (LIM) to this address instead, and use it for everything that follows.

Mit freundlichen Gruessen / Kind regards
Jonas Kessler
Logistics Coordinator
Kessler Feinmechanik GmbH, Ulm

classification.reasoning: The customer provides an updated email address for an existing shipment offer, rather than requesting a new quote.
